srs_deltas.detail: Interrupts are not covered by the SRS. Implemented and tested as declared behaviour: a thread whose interrupt status is set when a retry is decided makes no retry (the last failure or 502/503 is relayed unchanged, interrupt status kept); a wait interrupted after a connect failure throws that failure; a wait interrupted after a closed 502/503 (closed before waiting per the Implementation Note) answers through the error flow with an HttpException of that status, or the fired deadline's kind. Suggest an AC or Implementation Note recording this.

'Body sent to the backend was zero bytes' is implemented as: not chunked and length 0 (no body found by the pre-read, or Content-Length: 0). A client Transfer-Encoding: chunked request with an empty body is treated as not bodyless, since a streamed chunked body cannot be sent again.
